title: The Cat and the Cock

full_text:
A cunning cat crept into a barn and seized a rooster, seeking an excuse to devour him with a show of justice. "You disturb honest folks," hissed the cat, "crowing in the dead of night and waking laborers from their sleep!"

The cock replied: "I crow for their benefit, alerting them that dawn is near so they may begin honest toil."

"Be that as it may," snarled the cat, "you are an unnatural rogue who respects no family ties!"

"I do that only that hens may lay fertile eggs for our master's table," reasoned the cock.

The cat bared her claws: "Though your arguments are clever, I will not go without my breakfast!" and devoured him on the spot.
moral: A tyrant determined upon cruelty will always invent a hypocritical excuse.
